lastCompletedStory.title: WARNING: pollPlannerDeath now returns { kind: 'pane-died' } the instant isPaneA…

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 (CAM-479 review-round fix) closed a regression introduced by US-004/US-005's PlannerPollOutcome refactor: pollPlannerDeath's pane-died branch (plan-runner.ts) used to trust `!isPaneAlive(plannerPaneId)` as immediate proof of a planner failure once readPlannerReportFn was defined, dropping the confirmation re-read that the pre-refactor `isPlannerNoPrd` double-read pattern used to perform. The race: the planner writes prd.json and its pane exits inside the SAME poll tick, between the primary readPlannerReportFn() check at the top of the loop and the isPaneAlive() check right after it; without a second read, that legitimate completion was misreported as `{ kind: 'planner-failed', reason: 'planner pane exited before writing prd.json' }` and the auditor was never spawned, even though prd.json existed. Fix: extracted a tiny `resolvePlannerPaneDeathOutcome(readPlannerReportFn)` helper (mirrors the existing `checkEarlyDeath` extraction pattern from US-005) that, when the pane is confirmed dead, performs ONE more readPlannerReportFn() read before returning; a non-null result now returns `{ kind: 'completed' }` instead of `{ kind: 'pane-died' }`. The extraction was required, not cosmetic: inlining the confirmation read directly in pollPlannerDeath's pane-died branch pushed biome's noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity from 15 (the post-US-005 ceiling) to 16; pulling the two-line branch into its own named function brought it back under the limit, exactly the same fix shape US-005's own patterns.md entry documents for checkEarlyDeath. Test: added a same-tick race repro to test/plan-runner-no-prd.test.ts (readPlannerReportFn returns null on the first call, non-null on the second, pane already dead) asserting the result is 'audit-approved' (falls through to the auditor, which APPROVEs), NOT 'planner-failed', and that readCount reaches at least 2 (proving the confirmation re-read actually fired, not just that the outcome happened to be right). pollAuditorReport (the auditor-side sibling poll) was NOT touched: its pane-died branch (`if (!isPaneAlive(...)) return { ok: false, cause: 'pane-died' }`) has no equivalent primary-signal-then-confirm race in this story's scope (readPlanVerdictFn reads a written report file the same way, but the story text and its Layer-B repro were scoped exclusively to pollPlannerDeath/line 1302); a symmetric confirmation-read gap in pollAuditorReport, if real, is out of scope for this fix and worth a follow-up issue if discovered later. Quality gates run in full: bun run typecheck (clean), bun test (5911 pass/0 fail, includes the new race test), and the full bun run check:all spine (typecheck/test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet, all green). scripts/file-size-budget.json's src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts ceiling raised 2434->2453 (the extraction + doc comments net-added 19 lines) with a dated _ref note prepended and staged before the gate re-run, per the gate-discipline rubric (ceiling raised to the gate's own actual reported line count, not an assumed one).
